name: Single-Agent Methotrexate (8-Day Methotrexate/Folinic Acid) for Low-Risk GTN
cyclesNote: repeat every 14 days until the serum hCG level becomes undetectable, then give consolidation courses (three additional courses recommended after remission to reduce relapse); physician determined

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Low risk GTN is a clinical/staging category (FIGO stage I to III with prognostic score less than 7), not a molecular biomarker gate. Single agent methotrexate is first line monotherapy for low risk disease. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Gestational Trophoblastic Neoplasia v2.2026, Systemic Therapy for GTN, Regimens for Low-Risk GTN (GTN-D).

treatmentSetting: curative-intent primary therapy for low-risk GTN
supportiveCare: leucovorin (folinic acid) rescue is part of the regimen (days 2, 4, 6, 8).
verify adequate renal function before each course (methotrexate is renally cleared); assess for effusions that can sequester methotrexate.
monitor hepatic function; dactinomycin is the standard switch for methotrexate resistance or methotrexate induced liver function abnormalities (DeVita).
monitoring: serum hCG each cycle (response and remission tracking)

doseModificationRules.condition: methotrexate resistance (plateau or rising hCG) or methotrexate induced liver function abnormality
doseModificationRules.text: Switch to single agent dactinomycin per source; if resistant to sequential monotherapy, switch to multiagent EMA-CO (see gyn-gtn-emaco).
Hold and review; methotrexate is renally cleared and can be sequestered in effusions, increasing toxicity.

drugs.name: Methotrexate
drugs.notes: Source: NCCN GTN v2.2026, GTN-D 1 of 7 (category 1). Methotrexate 1 mg/kg IM (or IV) on days 1, 3, 5, and 7, alternating every other day with leucovorin rescue on days 2, 4, 6, and 8; repeat every 14 days. DeVita 12th ed. Table 51.2 (line 176999) prints the identical 8-day MTX/FA regimen (MTX 1 mg/kg IM or IV on days 1, 3, 5, 7). Requires adequate renal function; verify renal function before each course.

provenance.locator: GTN-D 1 of 7, Regimens for Low-Risk GTN, Preferred: Methotrexate 1 mg/kg IM every other day x 4 days (Days 1, 3, 5, and 7), repeat every 14 days (category 1)

drugs.name: Leucovorin (folinic acid)
drugs.notes: Source: NCCN GTN v2.2026, GTN-D 1 of 7. Leucovorin rescue 15 mg PO (preferred) or IM given 30 hours after each methotrexate dose on days 2, 4, 6, and 8. Source stated weight based alternative: 0.1 mg/kg rounded up to the nearest 5-mg increment. DeVita 12th ed. Table 51.2 (line 177001) prints FA 15 mg PO on days 2, 4, 6, 8. Leucovorin rescue is mandatory in this schedule.

provenance.locator: GTN-D 1 of 7, Leucovorin 0.1 mg/kg rounded up to the nearest 5-mg increment or 15 mg PO (preferred) or IM 30 hours after each methotrexate dose on Days 2, 4, 6, and 8
